rows.name: Eyemouth
rows.description: One red, one bright fixed light

rows.name: ST. ABB'S HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 29 ft. high; flash every 10 secs. Fog Horn, 1 blast of 6 secs. every 1½ min.

rows.name: Dunbar Old Harbour „ Victoria Harbour
rows.description: Old Harbour lt. br. toward entrance, but blue to W., red to E. Bright lt. at Victoria Harbour. Additional lts. in fishing season

rows.name: North Berwick
rows.description: Red lt. on North pier, October to April

rows.name: Cockenzie
rows.description: Green light on East pier-head

rows.name: INCHKEITH
rows.description: A white tower, 45 ft. high, on the summit of the island

rows.name: Fisherrow
rows.description: On the pier-head; all night, except in moonlight

rows.name: Leith
rows.character: Green lt. on E. pier-head Red light on E. pier White light on W. pier
rows.description: A green lt. under the white one, on inner part of W. pier, while 10 ft. in Victoria Dock; the green changed to red when Dock gates are open Gong

rows.name: Newhaven
rows.description: One bright lt. on the pier, strengthened in the direction of Herwit Shoal

rows.name: Granton
rows.description: Red lt. on main pier-head. Fog Bell. Green lt. on E. and red lt. on W. breakwater heads

rows.name: Grangemouth
rows.description: At entr. of Ri[?]er Carron. On end of S. embankment, [?] reflected or apparent red lt. is also sho[?] N. side of entrance

rows.name: Charlestown
rows.description: One bright light on end of outer pier

rows.name: Inverkeithing
rows.description: Two red lights on West Quay

rows.name: St. David
rows.description: A bright fixed light

rows.name: Burntisland
rows.description: Red lt. on E. pier-head, and br. lts. on each of the railway piers, a short distance to the eastward, while the ferry is running. On the E. pier-head a green lt. below red lt. indicates, Keep in the offing. A red lt. at Newhalls, & a white lt. at Queensferry, for passage boats only

rows.name: Pettycur
rows.description: One bright fixed light on pier

rows.name: Kirkcaldy
rows.description: On East pier head. Red to seaward; white when harbour is open

rows.name: Dysart
rows.description: Green light

rows.name: W. Wemyss
rows.description: Red tide light

rows.name: Buckhaven
rows.description: A white light on East pier-head

rows.name: St. Monans
rows.character: One red, and one br. lt.
rows.description: One on pier-head; the other on a house; fishing lights

rows.name: Pittenweem
rows.description: One on pier-head, and one on a building. In bad weather a bright gas light is shown while 6 feet

rows.name: Anstruther
rows.description: On E. pier-head. Also two bright leading lts. at W. Anstruther

rows.name: Cellardyke
rows.description: On a house, in W. part of harbour; only while boats are out

rows.name: Crail
rows.description: Upper red, lower br. lt. From old stone beacons on top of cliff. Aug. 1 to April 30. Gas lts.
